kind: Read-only current-behavior/feasibility mapping before explicit scope approval; no architecture decision or new runtime samples

findings.sharedAllocator: AgentRunIdentityAllocator is shared across Org, Team, standalone provision, task/collaborator allocation and application execution scope. Historical membership-check changes are not isolated to a single UI button.
findings.testSemantics: Existing unit tests inject repeated tokens and assert collision scans/reservation/memory-path behavior. These assert current machinery; do not independently establish an approved product obligation to retain exhaustive historical scans. No tests executed this round.
findings.refreshCallers: Normal launch explicitly refreshes history; panel mounts/fetches and refreshes every 5000 ms; Org context/activity updates applyAgentOrgActivity, which locally projects activity then calls refreshAgentOrgHistory. Source caller map is not a measured attribution of each captured request.
findings.publication: Full history fetch independently publishes workspace and Org branches with request-generation guards, followed by another fetch-complete navigation refresh. These guards have explicit freshness semantics; preserved outcomes must not be mistaken for preserving all repeated work.
findings.runtimeSurfaces: RuntimeAvailabilityService already has getRuntimeAvailability(runtimeKind); inspected GraphQL query currently calls listRuntimeAvailabilities. This is a feasibility fact, not a selected API design.

setupCaveats: First guessed identity-test/capability-store paths did not exist; actual identity test found. No missing-coverage or application failure inferred.
